notes.title: The Definitive Edition for 99vidas is now live!
notes.content:
This major update brings more stages, a whole of gameplay visuals for the game, exciting features and a lot of new stuff that you can find in this new version of the game.


• All-new Arcade Mode – Double the size of the regular campaign with no dialogs to interrupt the flow – No Talk, All Action!
• All-new Remix Mode – Every new play is a different experience! This new mode mix things up by shuffling stages and enemies every time you start a new game.
• New Enemies
• New Stages
• Different visuals that you can customize it in the gameplay.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/557040/99Vidas/
